```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)


stan_data <- readRDS("data/stan_ready_data.Rds")
# ---- Configuration ----
DATA_ROOT <- "ecology/model_selection/data"

source("ecology/model_selection/models/gpath/gpath.R")

ff <- list.files("ecology/model_selection/data/gpath/")

run_configs <- lapply(ff,function(fi){
  list(model="gpath",constraint=fi,alias=fi)
})

# Refactor note: this model-level optimization summary block could eventually use
# helpers from R/posterior_io_utils.R once the stale path parsing here is removed.
results_list <- lapply(run_configs, function(cfg) {
  print(cfg$constraint)
  
  # 1. Construct the specific path for this config
  config_dir <- file.path(DATA_ROOT, cfg$model, cfg$constraint)
  
  if (!dir.exists(config_dir)) {
    warning(sprintf("Directory not found: %s", config_dir))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  draws_path <- file.path(config_dir,"hier", "optim_draws_all.Rds")
  
  all_draws <- do.call(rbind,readRDS(draws_path))
  
  best_lp <- max(all_draws[,"log_lik"],na.rm=T)
  if (is.null(best_lp)) return(NULL)
  rel_path <- sub(paste0(config_dir, "/"), "", f)
  parts <- strsplit(rel_path, "/")[[1]]
    
    # We expect at least CELL/PLOIDY components

  cellLine <- parts[1]
  ploidy   <- parts[2]
    
  if(cellLine=="hier") ploidy <- "hier"
    
  data.frame(
      alias      = cfg$alias,     # Use the user-defined alias
      model      = cfg$model,
      constraint = cfg$constraint,
      cellLine   = cellLine,
      ploidy     = ploidy,
      best_lp    = best_lp,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

format_alias <- function(run_id) {
  matches <- as.integer(regmatches(run_id, gregexpr("[0-9]+", run_id))[[1]])
  if (length(matches) < 4) return(run_id)
  
  R <- matches[1]; P <- matches[2]; W <- matches[3]; C <- matches[4]
  # Assuming M is the 5th match if present, default to 1 if missing
  M <- if(length(matches) >= 5) matches[5] else 1 
  
  # Build descriptors
  c_str <- ifelse(C == 1, "Specialized", "Dense")
  w_str <- ifelse(W > 0, sprintf(", %dW (%s)", W, ifelse(M == 1, "Add", "Mult")), "")
  
  sprintf("%dR-%dP %s%s", R, P, c_str, w_str)
}

# Apply it to your rows dataframe


# Bind the outer list (configs)
rows <- bind_rows(results_list)


rows$alias <- sapply(rows$constraint, format_alias)

rows <- rows[!rows$cellLine=="holdout",]

if (nrow(rows) == 0) stop("No valid data found for any configuration.")

# Create grouping variable
rows$condition <- interaction(rows$cellLine, rows$ploidy, sep = " ")

rows$k <- sapply(rows$constraint,get_hierarchical_k,N_lines=5)
rows$AIC <- 2*rows$k-2*rows$best_lp
rows$AIC <- rows$AIC-min(rows$AIC)

p1 <- ggplot(rows, aes(x = reorder(alias, AIC), y = AIC)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey30", width = 0.7) + 
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(expression(Delta~AIC~(lower~is~Better))) +
  scale_x_discrete("") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )



# 1. Calculate Deviance
rows$deviance <- -2 * rows$best_lp

# 2. Extract strictly non-dominated Pareto front
pareto_front <- rows %>%
  arrange(k, deviance) %>%
  # Keep only models that tie or beat the best deviance seen so far
  filter(deviance == cummin(deviance)) %>%
  # If there's a tie in deviance, strictly prefer the one with fewer parameters
  group_by(deviance) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = k, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(k)

# 3. Plot
p2 <- ggplot(rows, aes(x = k, y = deviance)) +
  # All tested models in the background
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.4, color = "grey60") +
  # Pareto frontier line and points
  geom_line(data = pareto_front, color = "firebrick", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = pareto_front, size = 4, color = "firebrick") +
  # Labels ONLY for the Pareto frontier
  geom_text_repel(
    data = pareto_front, 
    aes(label = alias), 
    box.padding = 0.6,
    point.padding = 0.4,
    size=2,
    nudge_y = max(rows$deviance) * 0.01 # slight upward nudge
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Effective Parameters (k)",
    y = expression(Deviance~(-2 * ln(hat(L))))
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
p1 + p2
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

base_path <- "ecology/model_selection/data/gpath/"
model_ids <- rows$constraint
model_ids <- c(  "1R_1P_0W_C0_M1","1R_1P_1W_C0_M1",
                 "2R_1P_0W_C0_M1","2R_2P_0W_C0_M1",
                 "2R_2P_1W_C0_M1")[1:4]

param_patterns <- c("^raw_")#, "^G1_0\\[")
regex_string <- paste(param_patterns, collapse = "|")

near_cut <- 5
# Refactor note: `get_model_detail()` and `process_model_fits()` both repeat
# optimization-output loading and LP-neighborhood bookkeeping. That logic could
# move to R/posterior_io_utils.R (`load_optim_outputs()` and
# `summarize_lp_neighborhood()`).
get_model_detail <- function(model_id, near_cut = 5) {
  lp <- readRDS(file.path(base_path, model_id, "hier/optim_lp_all.Rds"))
  draws <- readRDS(file.path(base_path, model_id, "hier/optim_draws_all.Rds"))
  
  finite_mask <- is.finite(lp)
  best_lp <- max(lp[finite_mask])
  lp_diff <- rep(NA_real_, length(lp))
  lp_diff[finite_mask] <- best_lp - lp[finite_mask]
  near_idx <- which(finite_mask & lp_diff < near_cut)
  if (length(near_idx) < 2) stop("Fewer than 2 near-best fits.")
  
  X <- do.call(rbind, draws[near_idx])
  X <- X[, grepl(regex_string, colnames(X)), drop = FALSE]
  if (!is.matrix(X)) X <- as.matrix(X)
  
  corX <- cor(X)
  
  sds <- apply(X, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  X <- X[, is.finite(sds) & sds > 0, drop = FALSE]
  Xs <- scale(X)
  pca <- prcomp(Xs, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
  
  var_df <- data.frame(
    param = colnames(X),
    sd = apply(X, 2, sd),
    mean = colMeans(X),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>% arrange(desc(sd))
  
  load1 <- data.frame(param = rownames(pca$rotation), loading = pca$rotation[,1], abs_loading = abs(pca$rotation[,1])) %>% arrange(desc(abs_loading))
  load2 <- data.frame(param = rownames(pca$rotation), loading = pca$rotation[,2], abs_loading = abs(pca$rotation[,2])) %>% arrange(desc(abs_loading))
  
  list(
    model_id = model_id,
    near_idx = near_idx,
    lp = lp[near_idx],
    lp_diff = lp_diff[near_idx],
    X = X,
    corX=corX,
    Xs = Xs,
    pca = pca,
    var_df = var_df,
    load1 = load1,
    load2 = load2
  )
}
process_model_fits <- function(model_id, near_cut = 5) {
  lp_path <- file.path(base_path, model_id, "hier/optim_lp_all.Rds")
  draws_path <- file.path(base_path, model_id, "hier/optim_draws_all.Rds")
  if (!file.exists(lp_path) || !file.exists(draws_path)) return(NULL)
  
  lp <- readRDS(lp_path)
  n_total <- length(lp)
  finite_mask <- is.finite(lp)
  n_finite <- sum(finite_mask)
  
  if (n_finite == 0) {
    summary_df <- data.frame(
      model_id = model_id, n_total = n_total, n_finite = 0, prop_finite = 0,
      n_nan = n_total, prop_nan = 1, best_lp = NA_real_,
      n_near_1 = 0, prop_near_1 = 0, n_near_5 = 0, prop_near_5 = 0, n_near_10 = 0, prop_near_10 = 0
    )
    bins_df <- data.frame(model_id = model_id, category = factor("NaN", levels = c("NaN","lp_diff >= 10","5 <= lp_diff < 10","1 <= lp_diff < 5","lp_diff < 1")), n = n_total)
    return(list(summary = summary_df, bins = bins_df, pca = NULL))
  }
  
  best_lp <- max(lp[finite_mask])
  lp_diff <- rep(NA_real_, n_total)
  lp_diff[finite_mask] <- best_lp - lp[finite_mask]
  near_idx <- which(finite_mask & lp_diff < near_cut)
  
  summary_df <- data.frame(
    model_id = model_id,
    n_total = n_total,
    n_finite = n_finite,
    prop_finite = n_finite / n_total,
    n_nan = sum(!finite_mask),
    prop_nan = mean(!finite_mask),
    best_lp = best_lp,
    n_near_1 = sum(finite_mask & lp_diff < 1),
    prop_near_1 = mean(finite_mask & lp_diff < 1),
    n_near_5 = sum(finite_mask & lp_diff < 5),
    prop_near_5 = mean(finite_mask & lp_diff < 5),
    n_near_10 = sum(finite_mask & lp_diff < 10),
    prop_near_10 = mean(finite_mask & lp_diff < 10)
  )
  
  cat_vec <- rep(NA_character_, n_total)
  cat_vec[!finite_mask] <- "NaN"
  cat_vec[finite_mask & lp_diff >= 10] <- "lp_diff >= 10"
  cat_vec[finite_mask & lp_diff < 10 & lp_diff >= 5] <- "5 <= lp_diff < 10"
  cat_vec[finite_mask & lp_diff < 5 & lp_diff >= 1] <- "1 <= lp_diff < 5"
  cat_vec[finite_mask & lp_diff < 1] <- "lp_diff < 1"
  
  bins_df <- data.frame(model_id = model_id, category = factor(cat_vec, levels = c("NaN","lp_diff >= 10","5 <= lp_diff < 10","1 <= lp_diff < 5","lp_diff < 1"))) %>%
    count(model_id, category, name = "n")
  
  if (length(near_idx) < 2) return(list(summary = summary_df, bins = bins_df, pca = NULL))
  
  draws <- readRDS(draws_path)
  draws_mat <- do.call(rbind, draws[near_idx])
  keep_cols <- grepl(regex_string, colnames(draws_mat))
  X <- draws_mat[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
  if (!is.matrix(X)) X <- as.matrix(X)
  
  sds <- apply(X, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  X <- X[, is.finite(sds) & sds > 0, drop = FALSE]
  if (!ncol(X)) return(list(summary = summary_df, bins = bins_df, pca = NULL))
  
  Xs <- scale(X)
  
  pca_df <- NULL
  if (nrow(Xs) >= 2 && ncol(Xs) >= 2) {
    pca <- prcomp(Xs, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
    pca_df <- data.frame(model_id = model_id, fit_id = near_idx, lp = lp[near_idx], lp_diff = lp_diff[near_idx], PC1 = pca$x[,1], PC2 = pca$x[,2])
  } else if (nrow(Xs) >= 2 && ncol(Xs) == 1) {
    pca_df <- data.frame(model_id = model_id, fit_id = near_idx, lp = lp[near_idx], lp_diff = lp_diff[near_idx], PC1 = Xs[,1], PC2 = 0)
  }
  
  list(summary = summary_df, bins = bins_df, pca = pca_df)
}

results <- map(model_ids, process_model_fits, near_cut = near_cut)

summary_tbl <- map_dfr(results, "summary") %>% arrange(desc(prop_near_5), desc(best_lp))
bins_tbl <- map_dfr(results, "bins")
pca_tbl <- map_dfr(results, "pca")

p_bins <- ggplot(bins_tbl, aes(x = reorder(model_id, n, sum), y = n, fill = category)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Fraction of starts", fill = "", title = "Optimization outcome profile by model")

p_near <- ggplot(summary_tbl, aes(x = reorder(model_id, prop_near_5), y = prop_near_5)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Fraction with lp_diff < 5", title = "Near-best capture rate")

p_pca <- ggplot(pca_tbl, aes(PC1, PC2, color = lp_diff)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~model_id, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2", color = "lp diff", title = "Near-best parameter continuity (PCA)")

print(summary_tbl)
print(p_bins)
print(p_near)
print(p_pca)
```

```{r}
# Refactor note: this and the later posterior-simulation chunks repeat the same

# 1. Generate Data (Simulations + Ribbon + Observations)
ll_well <- function(model_ID, n_draws = 50) {
  # Parse Dimensions
  dims <- parse_run_id(model_ID)
  R <- dims$R; P <- dims$P; W <- dims$W; C <- dims$C; M <- dims$M
  strict_spec <- (C == 1)
  L <- 3 * R + (P - 1) * R + W * R + 1
  
  # Load Data and map groups
  stan_data <- readRDS("data/stan_ready_data.Rds")
  grp_keys <- paste(stan_data$line_id, stan_data$ploidy_metric, sep = "_")
  unique_grps <- unique(grp_keys)
  stan_data$N_groups <- length(unique_grps)
  stan_data$group_id <- match(grp_keys, unique_grps)
  
  
  # Load Chains
  chain_dir <- file.path("ecology/model_selection/data/gpath", model_ID, "hier/nuts")
  chain_files <- list.files(chain_dir, pattern = "nuts_draws_[0-9]+\\.Rds", full.names = TRUE)
  
  x <- as_draws_matrix(do.call(bind_draws, c(lapply(chain_files, readRDS), along = "chain")))
  
  x <- x[,grepl("ll_well",colnames(x))]
  ll <- apply(x,2,median)
  
  data.frame(ll=ll,cellLine=names(stan_data$line_map)[stan_data$line_id],
             ploidy=ifelse(stan_data$ploidy_metric>0,"hi","lo"),
             G=stan_data$G0_per_well,model_id=model_ID)
  
  
}
```

```{r}
library(deSolve)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
source("ecology/model_selection/models/gpath/gpath.R")

# 1. Generate Data (Simulations + Ribbon + Observations)
# Refactor note: the repeated gpath run setup in this section could be replaced
# by shared helpers from R/gpath_run_utils.R and R/posterior_io_utils.R.
generate_pars <- function(model_ID, n_draws = 50,cv=FALSE) {
  # Parse Dimensions
  dims <- parse_run_id(model_ID)
  R <- dims$R; P <- dims$P; W <- dims$W; C <- dims$C; M <- dims$M
  strict_spec <- (C == 1)
  L <- 3 * R + (P - 1) * R + W * R + 1
  
  # Load Data and map groups
  stan_data <- readRDS("data/stan_ready_data.Rds")
  grp_keys <- paste(stan_data$line_id, stan_data$ploidy_metric, sep = "_")
  
  xmpl_wells <- which(!duplicated(grp_keys)) ## these cover our 10 ploidy x cell line combos.
  
  # Load Chains
  chain_dir <- file.path("ecology/model_selection/data/gpath", model_ID, "hier/nuts")
  
  chain_files <- list.files(chain_dir, pattern = "nuts_draws_[0-9]+\\.Rds", full.names = TRUE)
  
  x <- as_draws_matrix(do.call(bind_draws, c(lapply(chain_files, readRDS), along = "chain")))
  
  # Helper to simulate a single draw and optionally add observation noise
  get_pars <- function(draw_vals, well_idx) {
    group_id <- stan_data$group_id[well_idx]
    p_metric <- stan_data$ploidy_metric[well_idx]
    p_metric <- stan_data$ploidy_metric[well_idx]
    
    raw_theta_line <- draw_vals[sprintf("raw_theta_line[%d,%d]", 1:L, target_line_id)]
    raw_theta_ploidy <- draw_vals[sprintf("raw_theta_ploidy[%d]", 1:L)]
    
    parms <- reconstruct_parms(
      R = R, P = P, W = W, strict_spec = strict_spec, M = M, 
      base_priors = base_priors, raw_theta_line = raw_theta_line, 
      raw_theta_ploidy = raw_theta_ploidy, ploidy_metric = p_metric
    )
    
    return(parms)
  }

  do.call(rbind,lapply(xmpl_wells,function(i){
    draw_indices <- sample(seq_len(nrow(x)), min(n_draws, nrow(x)))
    all_draws <- data.frame(do.call(rbind,pbapply::pblapply(draw_indices, function(d_idx) {
      vals <- as.numeric(x[d_idx, ])
      names(vals) <- colnames(x)
      unlist(get_pars(vals,i))
    })))
    all_draws$ploidy_metric <- stan_data$ploidy_metric[i]
    all_draws$cellLine <- names(stan_data$line_map)[stan_data$line_id[i]]
    all_draws
  }))
  
}

               "2R_2P_0W_C0_M1", "2R_2P_1W_C0_M1")

x <- generate_pars(model_ids[4])
```

```{r}
# 1. Generate Data (Simulations + Ribbon + Observations)
post_growth_curves <- function(model_ID, n_draws = 50) {
  # Parse Dimensions
  dims <- parse_run_id(model_ID)
  R <- dims$R; P <- dims$P; W <- dims$W; C <- dims$C; M <- dims$M
  strict_spec <- (C == 1)
  L <- 3 * R + (P - 1) * R + W * R + 1
  
  # Load Data and map groups
  stan_data <- readRDS("data/stan_ready_data.Rds")
  grp_keys <- paste(stan_data$line_id, stan_data$ploidy_metric, sep = "_")
  unique_grps <- unique(grp_keys)
  stan_data$N_groups <- length(unique_grps)
  stan_data$group_id <- match(grp_keys, unique_grps)
  
  
  # Load Chains
  chain_dir <- file.path("ecology/model_selection/data/gpath", model_ID, "hier/nuts")
  chain_files <- list.files(chain_dir, pattern = "nuts_draws_[0-9]+\\.Rds", full.names = TRUE)
  
  x <- as_draws_matrix(do.call(bind_draws, c(lapply(chain_files, readRDS), along = "chain")))
  
  df <- do.call(rbind,pbapply::pblapply(1:5,function(target_line_id){
    do.call(rbind,lapply(sample(1:nrow(x),n_draws),function(i){
      rtl <- x[i,sprintf("raw_theta_line[%d,%d]", 1:L, target_line_id)]
      rtp <- x[i,sprintf("raw_theta_ploidy[%d]", 1:L)]
      parms_lo <- reconstruct_parms(
        R = R, P = P, W = W, strict_spec = strict_spec, M = M, 
        base_priors = base_priors, raw_theta_line = rtl, 
        raw_theta_ploidy = rtp, ploidy_metric = 0
      )
      p_metric <- max(stan_data$ploidy_metric[stan_data$line_id==target_line_id])
      parms_hi <- reconstruct_parms(
        R = R, P = P, W = W, strict_spec = strict_spec, M = M, 
        base_priors = base_priors, raw_theta_line = rtl, 
        raw_theta_ploidy = rtp, ploidy_metric = p_metric
      )
      G <- exp(seq(log(0.001),log(10),length.out=20))
      do.call(rbind,lapply(G,function(Gi){
        y0 <- c(1,Gi,rep(1,R-1),rep(0,W))
        data.frame(line_id = target_line_id, G=Gi,ploidy=c("lo","hi"),
                   g=c(rhs(0,y0,parms_lo)[[1]][1],
                        rhs(0,y0,parms_hi)[[1]][1]))
      }))
      
    }))
  }))
  df$model_id <- model_ID
  return(df)
}
model_ids <- c("1R_1P_0W_C0_M1", "1R_1P_1W_C0_M1", "2R_1P_0W_C0_M1", "2R_2P_0W_C0_M1", "2R_2P_1W_C0_M1")

df <- do.call(rbind,lapply(model_ids,post_growth_curves))

smm <- aggregate(list(g=df$g),by=list(ploidy=df$ploidy,G=df$G,line_id=df$line_id,model_id=df$model_id),mean)

smm$cellLine <- names(stan_data$line_map)[smm$line_id]

p <- ggplot(smm,aes(x=G,y=24*g,color=ploidy,group=ploidy))+
```

```{r}
# 1. Generate Data (Simulations + Ribbon + Observations)
comp_curves <- function(model_ID, n_draws = 25) {
  # Parse Dimensions
  dims <- parse_run_id(model_ID)
  R <- dims$R; P <- dims$P; W <- dims$W; C <- dims$C; M <- dims$M
  strict_spec <- (C == 1)
  L <- 3 * R + (P - 1) * R + W * R + 1
  
  # Load Data and map groups
  stan_data <- readRDS("data/stan_ready_data.Rds")
  grp_keys <- paste(stan_data$line_id, stan_data$ploidy_metric, sep = "_")
  unique_grps <- unique(grp_keys)
  stan_data$N_groups <- length(unique_grps)
  stan_data$group_id <- match(grp_keys, unique_grps)
  
  
  # Load Chains
  chain_dir <- file.path("ecology/model_selection/data/gpath", model_ID, "hier/nuts")
  chain_files <- list.files(chain_dir, pattern = "nuts_draws_[0-9]+\\.Rds", full.names = TRUE)
  
  x <- as_draws_matrix(do.call(bind_draws, c(lapply(chain_files, readRDS), along = "chain")))
  
  df <- do.call(rbind,pbapply::pblapply(1:5,function(target_line_id){
    do.call(rbind,lapply(sample(1:nrow(x),n_draws),function(i){
      rtl <- x[i,sprintf("raw_theta_line[%d,%d]", 1:L, target_line_id)]
      rtp <- x[i,sprintf("raw_theta_ploidy[%d]", 1:L)]
      parms_lo <- reconstruct_parms(
        R = R, P = P, W = W, strict_spec = strict_spec, M = M, 
        base_priors = base_priors, raw_theta_line = rtl, 
        raw_theta_ploidy = rtp, ploidy_metric = 0
      )
      p_metric <- max(stan_data$ploidy_metric[stan_data$line_id==target_line_id])
      parms_hi <- reconstruct_parms(
        R = R, P = P, W = W, strict_spec = strict_spec, M = M, 
        base_priors = base_priors, raw_theta_line = rtl, 
        raw_theta_ploidy = rtp, ploidy_metric = p_metric
      )
      
      Gi <- 1
      parms <- combine_parms(parms_lo,parms_hi)
      y0 <- c(500,500,Gi,rep(1,R-1),rep(0,W))
      
      out <- ode(y0,times=0:144,func = rhs_mix,parms = parms)
      
      
      
      G <- c(0.0,0.1,0.25,0.5,1)
      do.call(rbind,lapply(G,function(Gi){
        y0 <- c(500,500,Gi,rep(1,R-1),rep(0,W))
        out <- ode(y0,times=0:144,func = rhs_mix,parms = parms)
        out <- out[,1:3]
        colnames(out) <- c("time","N_lo","N_hi")
        out <- data.frame(out)
        out$line_id <- target_line_id
        out$G <- Gi
        out$draw <- i
        out
      }))
      
    }))
  }))
  df$model_id <- model_ID
  return(df)
}
model_ids <- c("1R_1P_0W_C0_M1", "1R_1P_1W_C0_M1", "2R_1P_0W_C0_M1", "2R_2P_0W_C0_M1", "2R_2P_1W_C0_M1")

df <- do.call(rbind,lapply(model_ids,comp_curves))

for(id in unique(df$line_id)){
  p <- ggplot(df[df$line_id==id,],aes(x=time,y=N_lo-N_hi,group=draw))+
  facet_grid(cols=vars(G),rows=vars(model_id),scales="free")+
  geom_line(alpha=0.2)+
    ggtitle(names(stan_data$line_map)[id])
 plot(p)  
}
```

```{r}
library(posterior)
library(matrixStats)

model_ids <- c("1R_1P_0W_C0_M1", "1R_1P_1W_C0_M1", "2R_1P_0W_C0_M1", "2R_2P_0W_C0_M1", "2R_2P_1W_C0_M1")
model_ids <- model_ids[c(1,2,4)]


stan_data <- readRDS("data/stan_ready_data.Rds")

N_holdout <- function(FOLD_ID,stan_data){
  line_vec   <- as.integer(stan_data$line_id)
  ploidy_vec <- as.numeric(stan_data$ploidy_metric)

  idx_line <- which(line_vec == FOLD_ID)
  if (!length(idx_line)) stop(sprintf("No wells found for line_id == %d", FOLD_ID))
  
  # Define "high ploidy" as max(ploidy_metric) within this line (robust to 0/1 or -0.5/+0.5)
  hi_ploidy <- max(ploidy_vec[idx_line], na.rm = TRUE)
  tol <- 1e-12
  idx_holdout <- which(line_vec == FOLD_ID & abs(ploidy_vec - hi_ploidy) < tol)
  
  sum(stan_data$well_idx_count%in%idx_holdout)+sum(stan_data$well_idx_gluc%in%idx_holdout)
}

process_baseline <- function(mid,n_chains=4){
  fs <- sprintf("ecology/model_selection/data/gpath/%s/holdout/nuts/nuts_draws_%01d.Rds", mid, 1:n_chains)
  fs <- fs[file.exists(fs)]
  dr <- Reduce(\(a,b) bind_draws(a, b, along="chain"), lapply(fs, \(x) as_draws_array(readRDS(x))))
  # Correct Bayesian ELPD calculation using log-sum-exp
  if ("log_lik_holdout" %in% variables(dr)) {
    ll_draws <- as.numeric(subset_draws(dr, variable="log_lik_holdout"))
    S <- length(ll_draws)
    elpd <- logSumExp(ll_draws) - log(S) 
  } else {
    elpd <- NA_real_
  }
  
   diags <- suppressWarnings(summarise_draws(dr, rhat=rhat, ess_bulk=ess_bulk))
  
  data.frame(
    model_id = mid,  elpd = elpd, 
    bad_rhat = sum(diags$rhat > 1.01, na.rm=TRUE), bad_ess = sum(diags$ess_bulk < 400, na.rm=TRUE)
  )
}

process_fold <- function(mid, fld, n_chains=4) {
  fs <- sprintf("ecology/model_selection/data/gpath/%s/hier/nuts_cv/nuts_draws_fold%02d_chain%02d.Rds", mid, fld, 1:n_chains)
  fs <- fs[file.exists(fs)]
  
  if (length(fs) == 0) return(data.frame(model_id=mid, fold=fld, elpd=NA_real_, bad_rhat=NA_integer_, bad_ess=NA_integer_))
  
  dr <- Reduce(\(a,b) bind_draws(a, b, along="chain"), lapply(fs, \(x) as_draws_array(readRDS(x))))
  
  # Correct Bayesian ELPD calculation using log-sum-exp
  if ("log_lik_holdout" %in% variables(dr)) {
    ll_draws <- as.numeric(subset_draws(dr, variable="log_lik_holdout"))
    S <- length(ll_draws)
    elpd <- logSumExp(ll_draws) - log(S) 
  } else {
    elpd <- NA_real_
  }
  
  # Train calculation (optional, keeping for your reference)
  if ("log_lik_train" %in% variables(dr)) {
    llt_draws <- as.numeric(subset_draws(dr, variable="log_lik_train"))
    S_train <- length(llt_draws)
    llt <- logSumExp(llt_draws) - log(S_train)
  } else {
    llt <- NA_real_
  }
  
  diags <- suppressWarnings(summarise_draws(dr, rhat=rhat, ess_bulk=ess_bulk))
  
  data.frame(
    model_id = mid, fold = fld, elpd = elpd, ll_train = llt,
    bad_rhat = sum(diags$rhat > 1.01, na.rm=TRUE), bad_ess = sum(diags$ess_bulk < 400, na.rm=TRUE)
  )
}

# 1. Get the fold-level results
fold_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(model_ids, \(m) do.call(rbind, lapply(1:5, \(f) process_fold(m, f)))))
rownames(fold_results) <- NULL

# Assuming fold_results is the dataframe from the previous step
# You must provide the exact number of held-out observations for each fold.
# For example: obs_per_fold <- c(1200, 1500, 1100, 2000, 1400)

aggregate_elpd_corrected <- function(df, obs_per_fold) {
  K <- length(unique(df$fold))
  
  # Ensure the dataframe is sorted by fold to match the obs_per_fold vector
  df <- df[order(df$fold), ]
  
  # 1. Normalize by observation count
  df$mean_pt_elpd <- df$elpd / obs_per_fold
  
  # 2. Calculate total ELPD and total N
  total_elpd <- sum(df$elpd, na.rm=TRUE)
  N_total <- sum(obs_per_fold)
  
  # 3. Calculate corrected SE
  var_pt_elpd <- var(df$mean_pt_elpd, na.rm=TRUE)
  se_total_elpd <- N_total * sqrt(var_pt_elpd / K)
  
  data.frame(
    constraint = df$model_id[1],
    total_elpd = total_elpd,
    se_elpd = se_total_elpd
  )
}

# Example usage (you will need to replace the obs_per_fold vector with your actual counts):
obs_counts <- sapply(1:5,N_holdout,stan_data=stan_data)
final_elpd_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(fold_results, fold_results$model_id), 
                                          \(x) aggregate_elpd_corrected(x, obs_counts)))
final_elpd_table <- final_elpd_table[order(final_elpd_table$total_elpd, decreasing=TRUE), ]
rownames(final_elpd_table) <- NULL

print(final_elpd_table)


elpd_df <- merge(final_elpd_table,rows[,c("constraint","deviance","k")])

# compute linear transform
a <- diff(range(elpd_df$deviance)) / diff(range(elpd_df$total_elpd))
b <- min(elpd_df$deviance) - a * min(elpd_df$total_elpd)

p3 <- ggplot(elpd_df, aes(x = k)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = total_elpd)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin =  (total_elpd - se_elpd),
                    ymax = (total_elpd + se_elpd))) +
  scale_y_continuous("Total ELPD")+
  scale_x_continuous("Effective Parameters (k)",breaks=unique(elpd_df$k))+
  theme_bw()
p3

F2 <- (p1 + p2 + p3) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(3, 3, 2)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(text = element_text(size = 6))

ggsave("plots/F2.png",plot=F2,width=8,height=3,units="in")
```

```{r}
library(deSolve)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
source("ecology/model_selection/models/gpath/gpath.R")

# 1. Generate Data (Simulations + Ribbon + Observations)
generate_line_data <- function(model_ID, target_line_id, n_draws = 50,cv=FALSE) {
  # Parse Dimensions
  dims <- parse_run_id(model_ID)
  R <- dims$R; P <- dims$P; W <- dims$W; C <- dims$C; M <- dims$M
  strict_spec <- (C == 1)
  L <- 3 * R + (P - 1) * R + W * R + 1
  
  # Load Data and map groups
  stan_data <- readRDS("data/stan_ready_data.Rds")
  grp_keys <- paste(stan_data$line_id, stan_data$ploidy_metric, sep = "_")
  unique_grps <- unique(grp_keys)
  stan_data$N_groups <- length(unique_grps)
  stan_data$group_id <- match(grp_keys, unique_grps)
  
  
  # Load Chains
  chain_dir <- file.path("ecology/model_selection/data/gpath", model_ID, "hier/nuts")
  
  chain_files <- list.files(chain_dir, pattern = "nuts_draws_[0-9]+\\.Rds", full.names = TRUE)
  
  if(cv){
    chain_dir <- file.path("ecology/model_selection/data/gpath", model_ID, "hier/nuts_cv")
    chain_files <- list.files(chain_dir, 
                            pattern = paste0("nuts_draws_fold0",target_line_id,"_chain0[0-9]+\\.Rds"),
                            full.names = TRUE)
  }
  
  x <- as_draws_matrix(do.call(bind_draws, c(lapply(chain_files, readRDS), along = "chain")))
  
  target_wells <- which(stan_data$line_id == target_line_id)
  line_name <- names(stan_data$line_map)[stan_data$line_map == target_line_id]
  times <- seq(0, max(stan_data$t_grid), length.out = 200)
  
  # Helper to simulate a single draw and optionally add observation noise
  run_sim <- function(draw_vals, well_idx, add_noise = FALSE) {
    group_id <- stan_data$group_id[well_idx]
    p_metric <- stan_data$ploidy_metric[well_idx]
    p_metric <- stan_data$ploidy_metric[well_idx]
    
    N0_raw <- draw_vals[sprintf("raw_N0[%d]", group_id)]
    N0 <- exp(log(500) + N0_raw * 1.0) 
    G1_0 <- draw_vals[sprintf("G1_0[%d]", well_idx)]
    
    raw_theta_line <- draw_vals[sprintf("raw_theta_line[%d,%d]", 1:L, target_line_id)]
    raw_theta_ploidy <- draw_vals[sprintf("raw_theta_ploidy[%d]", 1:L)]
    
    parms <- reconstruct_parms(
      R = R, P = P, W = W, strict_spec = strict_spec, M = M, 
      base_priors = base_priors, raw_theta_line = raw_theta_line, 
      raw_theta_ploidy = raw_theta_ploidy, ploidy_metric = p_metric
    )
    
    y0 <- c(N = max(as.numeric(N0), 1e-6), R1 = as.numeric(G1_0))
    if (R > 1) y0 <- c(y0, setNames(pmax(rep(1.0, R-1), 0), paste0("R", 2:R)))
    if (W > 0) y0 <- c(y0, setNames(rep(0.0, W), paste0("W", 1:W)))
    
    out <- as.data.frame(deSolve::ode(y = y0, times = times, func = rhs, parms = parms, method = "lsoda"))
    
    if (add_noise) {
      # 1. Observation Noise for N (Lognormal)
      sigma_N <- if ("sigma_N" %in% names(draw_vals)) draw_vals["sigma_N"] else exp(log(0.2) + draw_vals["raw_sigma_N"] * 0.5)
      out$N <- pmax(0, rlnorm(nrow(out), log(pmax(out$N, 0) + 1.0), sigma_N) - 1.0)
      
      # 2. Observation Noise for R1 (via Luminescence)
      exp_id <- stan_data$exp_id[well_idx]
      a_fix <- stan_data$calib_a_fixed[exp_id]
      b_fix <- stan_data$calib_b_fixed[exp_id]
      sig_fix <- stan_data$calib_sigma_fixed[exp_id]
      
      dil_idx <- which(stan_data$well_idx_gluc == well_idx)
      mean_dil <- if (length(dil_idx) > 0) mean(stan_data$dilution[dil_idx]) else 1.0
      
      mu <- a_fix * pmax(out$R1, 0) * mean_dil + b_fix
      lum_sim <- rlnorm(nrow(out), log(pmax(mu, 1e-12)), sig_fix)
      out$R1 <- pmax(0, (lum_sim - b_fix) / (a_fix * mean_dil + 1e-12))
    }
    
    out_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(out, cols = -time, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value")
    out_long$well_idx <- well_idx
    out_long$ploidy_abs <- stan_data$ploidy_abs[well_idx]
    out_long$G0 <- stan_data$G0_per_well[well_idx]
    out_long$line_name <- line_name
    return(out_long)
  }

  # --- 1A. Mean Trajectory ---
  mean_vals <- colMeans(as.matrix(x))
  names(mean_vals) <- colnames(x)
  df_mean <- do.call(rbind, lapply(target_wells, function(w) run_sim(mean_vals, w, add_noise = FALSE)))
  
  # --- 1B. Posterior Predictive Ribbon ---
  draw_indices <- sample(seq_len(nrow(x)), min(n_draws, nrow(x)))
  cat("Simulating predictive draws...\n")
  all_draws <- pbapply::pblapply(draw_indices, function(d_idx) {
    vals <- as.numeric(x[d_idx, ])
    names(vals) <- colnames(x)
    do.call(rbind, lapply(target_wells, function(w) run_sim(vals, w, add_noise = TRUE)))
  })
  
  df_ribbon <- do.call(rbind, all_draws) %>%
    group_by(time, Variable, well_idx, ploidy_abs, G0, line_name) %>%
    summarize(
      lower = quantile(Value, probs = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      upper = quantile(Value, probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # --- 1C. Experimental Observations ---
  idx_N <- stan_data$well_idx_count %in% target_wells
  obsN <- data.frame(
    well_idx = stan_data$well_idx_count[idx_N],
    time = stan_data$t_grid[stan_data$grid_idx_count[idx_N]],
    Value = as.numeric(stan_data$N_obs[idx_N]),
    Variable = "N"
  )
  
  idx_G <- stan_data$well_idx_gluc %in% target_wells
  wells_G <- stan_data$well_idx_gluc[idx_G]
  exps_G <- stan_data$exp_id[wells_G]
  
  lum <- as.numeric(stan_data$lum_obs[idx_G])
  dil <- as.numeric(stan_data$dilution[idx_G])
  obsG <- data.frame(
    well_idx = wells_G,
    time = stan_data$t_grid[stan_data$grid_idx_gluc[idx_G]],
    Value = pmax(0, (lum - stan_data$calib_b_fixed[exps_G]) / (stan_data$calib_a_fixed[exps_G] * dil + 1e-12)),
    Variable = "R1"
  )
  
  df_obs <- rbind(obsN, obsG)
  df_obs$ploidy_abs <- stan_data$ploidy_abs[df_obs$well_idx]
  df_obs$G0 <- stan_data$G0_per_well[df_obs$well_idx]
  df_obs$line_name <- line_name
  
  return(list(mean = df_mean, ribbon = df_ribbon, obs = df_obs))
}

# 2. Plot Data
plot_line_trajectories <- function(data_list, model_ID) {
  df_mean <- data_list$mean
  df_ribbon <- data_list$ribbon
  df_obs <- data_list$obs
  
  # Format G0 levels for faceting
  g0_levels <- sort(unique(df_mean$G0))
  g0_labels <- paste0("G[0]=", g0_levels)
  
  df_mean$G0_label <- factor(paste0("G[0]=", df_mean$G0), levels = g0_labels)
  df_ribbon$G0_label <- factor(paste0("G[0]=", df_ribbon$G0), levels = g0_labels)
  df_obs$G0_label <- factor(paste0("G[0]=", df_obs$G0), levels = g0_labels)
  
  vars_to_plot <- unique(df_mean$Variable)
  line_name <- df_mean$line_name[1]
  
  plot_list <- lapply(vars_to_plot, function(v) {
    sub_mean <- df_mean[df_mean$Variable == v, ]
    sub_ribbon <- df_ribbon[df_ribbon$Variable == v, ]
    sub_obs <- df_obs[df_obs$Variable == v, ]
    
    title_str <- v
    if (v == "N") title_str <- "N (alive cells)"
    if (v == "R1") title_str <- "R1: Glucose"
    
    p <- ggplot() +
      geom_ribbon(data = sub_ribbon, aes(x = time, ymin = lower, ymax = upper), fill = "dodgerblue", alpha = 0.25) +
      geom_line(data = sub_mean, aes(x = time, y = Value), linewidth = 1, color = "dodgerblue4")
    
    if (nrow(sub_obs) > 0) {
      p <- p + geom_point(data = sub_obs, aes(x = time, y = Value), color = "black", size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8)
    }
    
    p + facet_grid(rows = vars(G0_label), cols = vars(ploidy_abs), scales = "free") +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(title = title_str, x = "Time", y = "") +
      theme(
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey80", fill = NA)
      )
  })
  
  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, nrow = 1) + 
    plot_annotation(
      title = sprintf("Model: %s | Cell Line: %s", model_ID, line_name),
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
    )
  
  print(combined_plot)
  return(invisible(combined_plot))
}

model_ids <- c("1R_1P_0W_C0_M1", "1R_1P_1W_C0_M1", "2R_1P_0W_C0_M1",
               "2R_2P_0W_C0_M1", "2R_2P_1W_C0_M1")

model_ids <- model_ids[c(1,2,4)]

cv <-  FALSE

cv_tag <- ""
if(cv) cv_tag <- "cv_"

for(model_id in model_ids){
  for(line_id in 1:5){
    df_line <- generate_line_data(model_id, target_line_id = line_id,cv=cv)
    p <- plot_line_trajectories(df_line, model_id)
    outPath <- file.path("ecology/model_selection/plots/gpath",
                         model_id,
                         paste0(cv_tag,line_id,".png"))
    ggsave(outPath,plot=p,width=9,height=8,units = "in")  
  }
  
}
```

```{r}
library(posterior)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

get_grid <- function(model_ID) {
  # 1. Parse Dimensions and Settings
  dims <- parse_run_id(model_ID)
  R <- dims$R
  P <- dims$P
  W <- dims$W
  C <- dims$C
  M <- dims$M
  
  L <- 3 * R + (P - 1) * R + W * R + 1
  strict_spec <- (C == 1)
  
  # 2. Load Data and Models
  stan_data <- readRDS("data/stan_ready_data.Rds")
  
  source("ecology/model_selection/models/gpath/gpath.R") 
  
  # 3. Read and combine separate chain files
  chain_dir <- file.path("ecology/model_selection/data/gpath", model_ID, "hier/nuts")
  chain_files <- list.files(chain_dir, pattern = "nuts_draws_[0-9]+\\.Rds", full.names = TRUE)
  
  draws_list <- lapply(chain_files, readRDS)
  
  # Bind along chains, then immediately flatten chains/iterations into a draws_matrix
  x_array <- do.call(bind_draws, c(draws_list, along = "chain"))
  x <- as_draws_matrix(x_array)
  
  # 4. Identify Representative Wells
  well_map <- data.frame(
    well_id = 1:length(stan_data$line_id),
    line_id = stan_data$line_id,
    metric  = stan_data$ploidy_metric
  )
  
  rep_wells <- well_map %>%
    group_by(line_id) %>%
    summarise(
      lo_metric = min(metric),
      hi_metric = max(metric),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(line_id)
  
  line_names <- names(stan_data$line_map)[match(rep_wells$line_id, stan_data$line_map)]
  
  # 5. Construct Target Variable Names
  needed_vars <- sprintf("raw_theta_ploidy[%d]", 1:L)
  for (lid in rep_wells$line_id) {
    needed_vars <- c(needed_vars, sprintf("raw_theta_line[%d,%d]", 1:L, lid))
  }
  
  # 6. Extract Data and Strip Posterior Classes
  sub_mat <- subset_draws(x, variable = needed_vars)
  
  # Strip all draws_matrix attributes so base R row subsetting yields a named vector
  mat_data <- as.matrix(sub_mat)
  class(mat_data) <- "matrix" 
  
  # 7. Grid Definition
  ggrid <- expand.grid(
    G1 = exp(seq(log(0.001), log(10), length.out = 20)),
    G2 = exp(seq(log(0.001), log(1), length.out = 10))
  )
  
  draw_indices <- sample(seq_len(nrow(mat_data)), min(200, nrow(mat_data)))
  
  # 8. Iterate and compute
  final_df <- do.call(rbind, pbapply::pblapply(draw_indices, function(draw_i) {
    
    # row_vals is now a standard named numeric vector
    row_vals <- mat_data[draw_i, ]
    
    # This will now correctly extract the numeric values instead of NAs
    raw_theta_ploidy <- row_vals[sprintf("raw_theta_ploidy[%d]", 1:L)]
    
    do.call(rbind, lapply(1:nrow(rep_wells), function(line_idx) {
      lid <- rep_wells$line_id[line_idx]
      cline <- line_names[line_idx]
      
      raw_theta_line <- row_vals[sprintf("raw_theta_line[%d,%d]", 1:L, lid)]
      
      params_lo <- reconstruct_parms(
        R, P, W, strict_spec, M, base_priors, 
        raw_theta_line, raw_theta_ploidy, rep_wells$lo_metric[line_idx]
      )
      
      params_hi <- reconstruct_parms(
        R, P, W, strict_spec, M, base_priors, 
        raw_theta_line, raw_theta_ploidy, rep_wells$hi_metric[line_idx]
      )
      
      grid_results <- t(apply(ggrid, 1, function(row) {
        state_vec <- c(N = 1, G1 = row["G1"])
        if (R > 1) state_vec <- c(state_vec, G2 = row["G2"])
        if (W > 0) state_vec <- c(state_vec, rep(0.0, W))
        
        dn_lo <- rhs(0, state_vec, params_lo)[[1]][1]
        dn_hi <- rhs(0, state_vec, params_hi)[[1]][1]
        
        c(dn_lo, dn_hi)
      }))
      
      data.frame(
        draw_index = draw_i,
        cellLine   = cline,
        G1         = ggrid$G1,
        G2         = ggrid$G2,
        g_lo       = grid_results[, 1],
        g_hi       = grid_results[, 2]
      )
    }))
  }))
  
  final_df$winlo <- final_df$g_lo > final_df$g_hi
  
  smm <- aggregate(
    list(fwin = final_df$winlo), 
    by = list(cellLine = final_df$cellLine, G1 = final_df$G1, G2 = final_df$G2), 
    mean
  )
  
  smm$id <- model_ID
  return(smm)
}

model_ids <- c("1R_1P_0W_C0_M1", "1R_1P_1W_C0_M1", "2R_1P_0W_C0_M1",
               "2R_2P_0W_C0_M1", "2R_2P_1W_C0_M1")

smm <- do.call(rbind, lapply(model_ids, get_grid))

p <- ggplot(smm, aes(x = G1, y = G2 * 100, fill = fwin)) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(id), cols = vars(cellLine)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_x_log10("Glucose (mM)") +
  scale_y_log10("R (%)") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c("P(lo>hi)") +
  ggtitle("probability low ploidy wins")+ 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        text = element_text(size=8))
print(p)
ggsave("plots/F_grids.png",plot=p,width=8,height=6,units="in")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Convert the draws object to a standard matrix
draws_mat <- as_draws_matrix(draws_combined)

# Compute the correlation matrix
cor_mat <- cor(draws_mat)

# Convert the matrix into a long-format data frame for sorting
cor_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_mat)) %>%
  rename(param1 = Var1, param2 = Var2, correlation = Freq) %>%
  # Convert factors to character strings
  mutate(param1 = as.character(param1),
         param2 = as.character(param2),
         abs_cor = abs(correlation)) %>%
  # Filter out self-correlations and duplicate pairs (since matrix is symmetric)
  filter(param1 < param2) %>%
  # Rank by the highest absolute correlation
  arrange(desc(abs_cor))

# Print the top 20 most highly correlated parameter pairs
print(head(cor_df, 20))

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# 1. Define the physical parameter names in the exact order Stan unpacks them
param_labels <- c(
  "ae_1", "ae_2", 
  "ah_1", "ah_2", 
  "Y_mat_1_1", "Y_mat_2_1", "Y_mat_1_2", "Y_mat_2_2", 
  "m"
)

# 2. Function to translate raw Stan variable names into descriptive names
annotate_param <- function(param_string) {
  
  # Handle 2D matrices (e.g., raw_theta_line[1, 5] -> Param 1, Line 5)
  if (grepl("\\[\\d+,\\s*\\d+\\]", param_string)) {
    base_name <- sub("\\[.*", "", param_string)
    idx_1 <- as.integer(sub(".*\\[(\\d+),.*", "\\1", param_string))
    idx_2 <- as.integer(sub(".*,\\s*(\\d+)\\].*", "\\1", param_string))
    
    if (base_name == "raw_theta_line") {
      return(sprintf("%s (Line %d)", param_labels[idx_1], idx_2))
    }
    return(param_string)
  }
  
  # Handle 1D vectors (e.g., raw_theta_ploidy[1] -> Param 1)
  if (grepl("\\[\\d+\\]", param_string)) {
    base_name <- sub("\\[.*", "", param_string)
    idx_1 <- as.integer(sub(".*\\[(\\d+)\\].*", "\\1", param_string))
    
    if (base_name == "raw_theta_ploidy") {
      return(sprintf("%s (Ploidy Effect)", param_labels[idx_1]))
    }
    if (base_name == "raw_N0") {
      return(sprintf("N0 (Group %d)", idx_1))
    }
    return(param_string)
  }
  
  # Return unchanged if no match (e.g., for sigma_N, m)
  return(param_string)
}

# 3. Apply the mapping to the correlation data frame
cor_df_annotated <- cor_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    param1_desc = annotate_param(param1),
    param2_desc = annotate_param(param2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Reorder columns to put descriptive names first
  select(param1_desc, param2_desc, correlation, abs_cor, param1, param2) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_cor))

# Print the readable pairs
print(head(cor_df_annotated, 20))

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Function to summarize and count highly correlated parameter pairs
summarize_correlations <- function(df_annotated, threshold = 0.8) {
  df_annotated %>%
    filter(abs_cor > threshold) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      # Extract the base parameter name by stripping out the entity tags in parentheses
      base_param1 = trimws(str_remove(param1_desc, "\\(.*\\)")),
      base_param2 = trimws(str_remove(param2_desc, "\\(.*\\)")),
      
      # Standardize the order alphabetically so A-B and B-A group together
      pair_name = paste(sort(c(base_param1, base_param2)), collapse = " - "),
      
      # Identify if the parameters belong to a specific line and extract the ID
      is_line1 = str_detect(param1_desc, "Line"),
      is_line2 = str_detect(param2_desc, "Line"),
      line_id1 = str_extract(param1_desc, "(?<=Line )\\d+"),
      line_id2 = str_extract(param2_desc, "(?<=Line )\\d+"),
      
      # Classify the relationship type
      rel_type = case_when(
        is_line1 & is_line2 & (line_id1 == line_id2) ~ "Within-Line",
        is_line1 & is_line2 & (line_id1 != line_id2) ~ "Between-Line",
        TRUE ~ "Global/Other"
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    # Group by the standardized pair name and relationship type
    group_by(pair_name, rel_type) %>%
    summarize(
      count = n(),
      avg_abs_cor = round(mean(abs_cor), 3),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    # Sort by the most frequent offenders first, then by the highest average correlation
    arrange(desc(count), desc(avg_abs_cor))
}

# Apply the condensation function
condensed_summary <- summarize_correlations(cor_df_annotated, threshold = 0.8)

# Print the top structural issues
print(head(condensed_summary, 20), n = 20)

library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

# 1. Convert draws and diagnostics to standard data frames
draws_df <- as_draws_df(draws_combined)
diags_df <- as_draws_df(diags_combined)

# 2. Bind the divergence flag to the parameter draws
# (as_draws_df preserves the precise iteration order)

  mutate(divergent = as.factor(diags_df$divergent__))

# 3. Separate the data to plot divergent points on top

nondiv_data <- filter(plot_df, divergent == "0")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(deSolve)
library(patchwork)
library(cmdstanr)

MODEL_NAME <- "gpath"
RUN_ID <- "2R_2P_1W_C0_M1" 

base_dir <- "ecology/model_selection"
fit_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "data", MODEL_NAME, RUN_ID, "hier")
plot_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "plots", MODEL_NAME, RUN_ID, "hier")
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

source(file.path(base_dir, "models", MODEL_NAME, paste0(MODEL_NAME, ".R")))

# Refactor note: the manual fit loading and stan-data augmentation below are a
# good candidate for extraction into R/gpath_run_utils.R once this legacy block
# is cleaned up.
get_best_hier_fit <- function(fit_dir) {
  d <- readRDS(file.path(fit_dir, "stan_data.Rds"))
  lp_vec <- readRDS(file.path(fit_dir, "optim_lp_all.Rds"))
  rc_vec <- readRDS(file.path(fit_dir, "optim_rc_all.Rds"))
  
  valid_idx <- which((rc_vec == 0L | rc_vec == 70L) & is.finite(lp_vec))
  if(length(valid_idx) == 0) stop("No valid fits found.")
  
  best_i <- valid_idx[which.max(lp_vec[valid_idx])]
  best_draw_mat <- readRDS(file.path(fit_dir, "optim_draws_all.Rds"))[[best_i]]
  
  list(d = d, params = setNames(as.numeric(best_draw_mat[1,]), colnames(best_draw_mat)))
}

process_hierarchical_data <- function(fit_data, config, run_flags) {
  d <- fit_data$d
  p_vec <- fit_data$params
  line_id_to_name <- setNames(names(d$line_map), unlist(d$line_map))
  sim_list <- vector("list", d$N_wells)
  
  state_names <- c("N", paste0("G", 1:config$R), if(config$W > 0) paste0("W", 1:config$W) else NULL)
  
  for(w in 1:d$N_wells) {
    lid <- d$line_id[w]
    p_metric <- d$ploidy_metric[w]
    
    raw_w <- numeric(config$L)
    for(k in 1:config$L) {
      raw_w[k] <- p_vec[[paste0("raw_theta_line[", k, ",", lid, "]")]] + 
                  p_vec[[paste0("raw_theta_ploidy[", k, "]")]] * p_metric
    }
    
    theta_phys <- exp(log(config$prior_centers) + raw_w * config$prior_scales)
    theta_mapped <- theta_phys[config$param_map] * config$param_mask
    
    ptr <- 1
    ae <- theta_mapped[ptr:(ptr+config$R-1)]; ptr <- ptr + config$R
    ah <- theta_mapped[ptr:(ptr+config$R-1)]; ptr <- ptr + config$R
    Y_mat <- matrix(theta_mapped[ptr:(ptr+config$P*config$R-1)], nrow=config$P, ncol=config$R, byrow=FALSE); ptr <- ptr + config$P*config$R
    
    if(config$W > 0) {
      K_mat <- matrix(theta_mapped[ptr:(ptr+config$W*config$R-1)], nrow=config$W, ncol=config$R, byrow=FALSE); ptr <- ptr + config$W*config$R
      tox <- theta_mapped[ptr:(ptr+config$W-1)]; ptr <- ptr + config$W
    } else {
      K_mat <- matrix(0, nrow=0, ncol=config$R)
      tox <- numeric(0)
    }
    m <- theta_mapped[ptr]
    
    parms <- list(R=config$R, P=config$P, W=config$W, ae=ae, ah=ah, Y_mat=Y_mat, K_mat=K_mat, tox=tox, m=m, waste_mech=rep(as.numeric(run_flags$M), config$W))
    
    y0 <- setNames(numeric(length(state_names)), state_names)
    y0["N"] <- exp(log(500) + p_vec[[paste0("raw_N0[", d$group_id[w], "]")]])
    g1_0_val <- if(paste0("G1_0[", w, "]") %in% names(p_vec)) p_vec[[paste0("G1_0[", w, "]")]] else d$G0_per_well[w]
    y0["G1"] <- g1_0_val
    
    if(config$R > 1) {
      for(c in 2:config$R) y0[paste0("G", c)] <- if(is.matrix(d$R_init_base)) d$R_init_base[w, c] else 1.0
    }
    
    out <- ode(y = y0, times = d$t_grid, func = rhs, parms = parms, method = "lsoda")
    
    sim_list[[w]] <- as.data.frame(out) %>%
      mutate(
        well = w,
        line_name = line_id_to_name[as.character(lid)],
        ploidy = if(p_metric < 0.1) "lo" else "hi",
        G0_val = d$G0_per_well[w], 
        G0_lbl = paste0("G0=", signif(d$G0_per_well[w], 3)),
        G1_0_est = g1_0_val
      )
  }
  
  obsN <- tibble(well = d$well_idx_count, time = d$t_grid[d$grid_idx_count], value = as.numeric(d$N_obs), type = "N")
  obsG <- tibble(well = d$well_idx_gluc, time = d$t_grid[d$grid_idx_gluc], lum = as.numeric(d$lum_obs), dil = as.numeric(d$dilution)) %>%
    mutate(exp = d$exp_id[well], value = pmax(0, (lum - d$calib_b_fixed[exp]) / (d$calib_a_fixed[exp] * dil + 1e-12)), type = "G1") %>%
    select(well, time, value, type)
  
  master_obs <- bind_rows(obsN, obsG) %>%
    mutate(
      line_name = line_id_to_name[as.character(d$line_id[well])],
      ploidy = if_else(d$ploidy_metric[well] < 0.1, "lo", "hi"),
      G0_val = d$G0_per_well[well],
      G0_lbl = paste0("G0=", signif(d$G0_per_well[well], 3))
    )
  
  list(sim = bind_rows(sim_list), obs = master_obs)
}

run_flags <- parse_run_id(RUN_ID)

config <- generate_stan_config(run_flags$R, run_flags$P, run_flags$W, run_flags$C == 1L, 0, base_priors)

fit_data <- get_best_hier_fit(fit_dir)
res <- process_hierarchical_data(fit_data, config, run_flags) 

for(line in unique(res$sim$line_name)) {
  p <- plot_results_grid(res$obs, res$sim, target_line = line, vars_to_plot = c(N=TRUE, G1=TRUE, G2=(config$R > 1)))
  ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0(line, "_hier_fit.png")), plot = p, width = 14, height = 8, units = "in")
}
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

constraints <- c("glucose_glutamine_limiting", "glucose_glutamine","glucose_simple")

source("ecology/model_selection/analysis_utils.R")
source("ecology/model_selection/pathways.R")

# --- 1. Initialize Aggregation Lists ---
global_sim <- list()
global_obs <- list()
global_params <- list()

# --- 2. Loop over Constraints to Load Data ---
for(constraint in constraints) {
  
  cat("Processing Constraint:", constraint, "...\n")
  
  # Construct path specific to this constraint
  # Note: logic changed to use the loop variable 'constraint'
  base_path <- file.path("ecology/model_selection/data/pathways", constraint)
  
  if(!dir.exists(base_path)) {
    warning(paste("Directory not found:", base_path))
    next
  }

  all_dirs <- list.dirs(base_path, recursive = TRUE)
  # Assuming stan_data.Rds indicates a valid fit directory
  fit_dirs <- all_dirs[file.exists(file.path(all_dirs, "stan_data.Rds"))]
  
  cat("  Found", length(fit_dirs), "directories.\n")

  for(fdir in fit_dirs) {
    # cat("  Loading:", fdir, "...\n") 
    res <- process_directory(fdir, ModelPathways)
    
    if(!is.null(res)) {
      # Create a unique key for the list (e.g., "constraint_path")
      key <- paste0(constraint, "_", fdir)
      
      # IMPORTANT: Tag the simulation data with the constraint name
      # This 'model' column triggers the multi-color plotting logic
      global_sim[[key]] <- res$sim %>% mutate(model = constraint)
      
      # We collect obs/params as well
      global_obs[[key]] <- res$obs
      global_params[[key]] <- res$params %>% mutate(model = constraint)
    }
  }
}

# --- 3. Aggregate Data ---
master_sim    <- bind_rows(global_sim)
master_params <- bind_rows(global_params)

# For observations, we likely loaded the same data twice (once for each model).
# We bind them, but then remove exact duplicates to avoid over-plotting points.
master_obs <- bind_rows(global_obs) %>% 
  distinct(line_name, time, type, G0_lbl, value, .keep_all = TRUE)

# --- 4. Plotting (Comparison) ---
unique_lines <- unique(master_sim$line_name)

# Create a shared output directory for comparisons
outDir <- "ecology/model_selection/plots/comparison"
if(!dir.exists(outDir)) dir.create(outDir, recursive = TRUE)

for(line in unique_lines) {
  cat("Plotting Line Fit:", line, "\n")
  
  # The plotting function will detect the 'model' column in master_sim
  # and automatically color the lines by constraint.
  p <- plot_results_grid(master_obs, master_sim, target_line = line,
                         vars_to_plot = c(N=TRUE, G1=TRUE, G2=TRUE, Lac=FALSE, Amm=FALSE))
  
  if(!is.null(p)) {
    fpath <- file.path(outDir, paste0(line, ".png"))
    ggsave(filename = fpath, plot = p, width = 6, height = 4, units = "in")
  }
}
```

```{r}
plot_data <- as_draws_df(ploidy_draws) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("raw_theta_ploidy"),
    names_to = "parameter_index",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract the numeric index from "raw_theta_ploidy[1]"
    idx = as.numeric(str_extract(parameter_index, "\\d+"))
  ) %>%
  # --- FILTER STEP ---
  # Keep only the parameters that are active in the constraint
  filter(idx %in% active_indices) %>%
  mutate(
    # Map to biological names using the Model object
    param_label = factor(Model$param_names[idx], levels = Model$param_names)
  )

# 4. Create the visualization
ppost <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = value, fill = as.factor(.chain), color = as.factor(.chain))) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30") + # Add reference line at 0
  facet_wrap(~ param_label, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Posterior Distributions of Ploidy Effects (Active Parameters)",
    subtitle = configs[[ix]]$alias,
    x = "Effect Size (Raw Scale)",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Chain",
    color = "Chain"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(ppost)
```




```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(posterior)

# 1. Setup paths
constraint <- "glucose_glutamine"
model <- "pathways"
base_path <- file.path("ecology/model_selection/data", model, constraint, "hier/nuts")

# 2. Load and merge the chains correctly
chain_files <- file.path(base_path, paste0("nuts_draws_", 1:4, ".Rds"))
draws_list <- lapply(chain_files, readRDS)

# FIX: Use do.call + along = "chain"
# This forces posterior to treat the objects as new chains for the same variables,
# ignoring the original chain IDs (which are likely all '1').
x <- do.call(bind_draws, c(draws_list, along = "chain"))

# 3. Load model metadata and constraints
source(file.path("ecology/model_selection/models", model, paste0(model, ".R")))
source(file.path("ecology/model_selection/models", model, "constraints.R"))

active_constraint <- constraints_list[[constraint]]
active_indices <- unique(active_constraint$map[active_constraint$mask == 1])

# 4. Subset and Process Data
plot_data <- x %>%
  subset_draws(variable = "raw_theta_ploidy") %>%
  as_draws_df() %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("raw_theta_ploidy"),
    names_to = "parameter_name",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    idx = as.numeric(str_extract(parameter_name, "\\d+"))
  ) %>%
  filter(idx %in% active_indices) %>%
  mutate(
    param_label = factor(Model$param_names[idx], levels = Model$param_names),
    chain_id = as.factor(.chain)
  )

# 5. Visualization
ppost <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = value, fill = chain_id, color = chain_id)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30") + 
  facet_wrap(~ param_label, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Posterior Distributions (Merged Chains)",
    subtitle = paste("Constraint:", constraint),
    x = "Effect Size",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Chain",
    color = "Chain"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(ppost)

```

```{r}
library(posterior)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# 1. Subset BOTH variable groups
# This excludes the massive 'theta_per_well' derived quantities but keeps the core hierarchy
target_draws <- subset_draws(x, variable = c("raw_theta_ploidy", "raw_theta_line"))

# 2. Compute Summary
# This usually takes a few seconds for ~1000-2000 parameters
ess_summary <- summarise_draws(target_draws, ess_bulk, ess_tail, rhat)

# 3. Parse and Filter
# logic: ploidy is [i], line is [line, i]. We need 'i' to match active_indices.
target_summary <- ess_summary %>%
  mutate(
    # Get all numbers from the string "variable[1,2]" -> c("1", "2")
    indices = str_extract_all(variable, "\\d+"),
    
    # Logic: If 1 number, it's the param index. If 2 numbers, the 2nd is the param index.
    param_idx = sapply(indices, function(x) {
      if(length(x) == 1) return(as.numeric(x[1]))       # ploidy[i]
      if(length(x) == 2) return(as.numeric(x[1]))       # line[line, i]
      return(NA)
    }),
    
    # Label the type for the report
    type = if_else(str_detect(variable, "line"), "Line-Specific", "Ploidy (Global)")
  ) %>%
  # --- FILTER STEP ---
  filter(param_idx %in% active_indices) %>%
  mutate(
    # Map to biological names
    param_name = Model$param_names[param_idx]
  ) %>%
  select(-indices) # Clean up list column
```


```{r}
library(posterior)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr) # useful for mapping/reducing if needed, but base R works too

constraint <- "glucose_glutamine"
model <- "pathways"
base_path <- file.path("ecology/model_selection/data", model, constraint, "hier/nuts")

# 1. Load and Merge Diagnostics
# We must load the 4 separate files and bind them along the 'chain' dimension
diag_files <- file.path(base_path, paste0("nuts_diagnostics_", 1:4, ".Rds"))

# Read files into a list
diag_list <- lapply(diag_files, readRDS)

# Merge them into one draws object
# 'along = "chain"' ensures they are treated as chains 1, 2, 3, 4
diagnostics <- do.call(bind_draws, c(diag_list, along = "chain"))

# Convert to data frame for easy analysis
diag_df <- as_draws_df(diagnostics)

# (Optional) Load summaries if needed, though your report below doesn't use 'smm'
# Summary files likely need to be re-computed from full draws for global Rhats,
# so simply binding them might not be statistically valid for all metrics.
# We will skip loading 'smm' here unless you specifically need it.


# --- HEALTH CHECK REPORT ---

cat("=== HMC DIAGNOSTICS REPORT ===\n")

# 1. Check Divergences
total_divergences <- sum(diag_df$divergent__)
total_draws <- nrow(diag_df)

cat(sprintf("Total Divergences: %d (%.2f%% of %d draws)\n", 
            total_divergences, 
            (total_divergences / total_draws) * 100,
            total_draws))

if (total_divergences > 0) {
  cat("  -> CRITICAL: Divergences detected.\n")
  cat("  -> SUGGESTION: Increase 'adapt_delta' (e.g., 0.95 or 0.99).\n")
} else {
  cat("  -> OK: No divergences.\n")
}

# 2. Check Tree Depth
# NUTS default cap is usually 10, but might be set higher in your run.
# We infer the cap by looking at the max depth reached, or you can hardcode it.
max_depth_hit <- max(diag_df$treedepth__)
prop_max_depth <- mean(diag_df$treedepth__ == max_depth_hit)

cat(sprintf("\nMax Tree Depth Hit: %d\n", max_depth_hit))
cat(sprintf("Percent of draws hitting max depth: %.2f%%\n", prop_max_depth * 100))

if (prop_max_depth > 0.01) { # If more than 1% hit the limit
  cat("  -> WARNING: Sampler is hitting the max_treedepth cap.\n")
  cat("  -> SUGGESTION: Increase 'max_treedepth' (e.g., 12 or 15).\n")
} else {
  cat("  -> OK: Tree depth looks healthy.\n")
}

# 3. Check E-BFMI (Energy)
# We calculate this per chain using the merged data
ebfmi_by_chain <- diag_df %>%
  group_by(.chain) %>%
  summarise(
    numer = sum(diff(energy__)^2),
    denom = var(energy__) * n(),
    ebfmi = numer / denom,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\nE-BFMI per chain (Should be > 0.3):\n")
print(ebfmi_by_chain)

if (any(ebfmi_by_chain$ebfmi < 0.3)) {
  cat("  -> WARNING: Low E-BFMI detected. Distribution may be hard to explore.\n")
  cat("  -> SUGGESTION: Check priors or re-parameterize (non-centered).\n")
} else {
  cat("  -> OK: Energy transitions look efficient.\n")
}



```
